dedupe_keys.name: relational database for building strong motion recordings used for seismic impact assessments

description: Relational Database for Building Strong Motion Recordings used for Seismic Impact Assessments is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Eusef Abdelmalek-Lee, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). Historical data plays a primary role in reconstructing building seismic responses and assessing damage in real time. While these types of data sets exist, they are often fragmented, difficult to access, and require significant manual manipulation on the part of the user to obtain useful information. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-t5ar-n620. Keywords: relational database, strong motion data, seismic response reconstruction, earthquakes, structural response measurements. Published 2022-09-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
